svg.title: GradePilot + Minason Games
svg.desc: GradePilot opens first. Press Ctrl+E or use the Open Games button to close GradePilot and launch Minason Games. Interactive use requires opening this SVG as a browser document.
svg.text: Interactive mode: use the original SVG from GitHub/jsDelivr as a browser page or iframe.
Image hosts that sanitize scripts will display this static preview instead.

xhtml:button.aria-label: Open Minason Games and close GradePilot
